title: Window Gaze
intro: Find a window, or just somewhere with a view. If there is no view, any far wall will do.

steps.text: Turn toward a window or the farthest point you can see.
Notice the light. Is it bright, soft, warm, cool?
Notice anything moving: leaves, clouds, people, or a flicker of reflection.
Let your gaze drift, with nothing to find and nowhere to be.
Take a slow breath and turn back, taking a little of that space with you.

closing: Back from the window. Carry on whenever you are ready.
